name: serious multi-turn conversation with emotional escalation
description: Tests the engine's topic tracking, sentiment scoring, and distress nudge behavior across a conversation that starts with a neutral observation and escalates to a serious emotional disclosure. Verifies that seriousness blocks humor, that sentiment history drives the distress nudge, and that topic continuity is maintained across turns.

turns.text: My job has been really stressful lately
I feel exhausted and anxious all the time
My boss keeps piling on work

expected.finalTurn: After 4 consecutive negative-sentiment turns (sentiment score < 0), the engine should track topics 'work', 'sleep', and 'anxiety'. The distress nudge (isInDistressStreak after DISTRESS_STREAK_LENGTH=3) should NOT have fired yet if DISTRESS_STREAK_LENGTH is checked against sentimentHistory length - verify exact condition.
expected.behavior: Topics are accumulated in memory (topicWeights, topicHistory). Sentiment score is negative for each turn. CurrentSubject updates to the most recently matched topic. Anxiety and work blend responses (blend_sleep_anxiety, blend_work_anger) should be checked.
